'''Orlin Denache''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the magister of the [[Taloraan City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Denache secretly signed a treaty with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who was interested in making [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Dooku, however, felt that the treaty was worthless and decided to take over the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] operations himself. A [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Canteval]] was sent to the planet and local Separatist supporters led by [[Rynert]] began to smuggle [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] into the city.

Meanwhile, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at Taloraan to ensure that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], accompanied by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Denache realized that the Jedi would detect his lies with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], so he faked illness and sent his emissary [[Sech Govlinder]] to negotiate in his place. However, after Tano accidentally discovered [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stocked within the city, Canteval ordered the droids to attack her and the other Jedi, revealing the Separatist presence within the city. The Jedi were captured, but Govlinder urged to keep them alive. After feeling manipulated by Dooku, Govlinder subsequently freed the Jedi and assisted them in retaking the city. After the Separatist forces were destroyed in the ensuing skirmish, Denache faced a dead-end. Having double-dealt the Republic and Dooku alike, he had no future, and committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] by stepping off the edge of the city and falling into the core of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].
